from pennylane.qchem.qaoa import QAOAniswanderer

def distance_matrix(coordinates):
    n = len(coordinates)
    distances = np.zeros((n, n))
    for i, (vertex1, pos1) in enumerate(coordinates.items()):
        for j, (vertex2, pos2) in enumerate(coordinates.items()):
            if i != j:
                distances[i, j] = np.linalg.norm(np.array(pos1) - np.array(pos2))
    return distances

    G.add_nodes_from(vertices)
    G.add_edges_from(edges)
    G.graph['distance_matrix'] = distances
    return G
